title: ObjectConnectorUser and ObjectJointUser state the marker types they need, by a parameter markerType
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.15.8 (maintainer 2026-10-26): the user connector and the user joint take a parameter of exu.MarkerType, given at creation, saying which marker type their markers must provide (Position, Position|Orientation, ...); Assemble checks the markers against it, and the user function can rely on it.
releaseNotes: ObjectConnectorUser has a parameter requestedMarkerType (exu.MarkerType, default _None for markers of any type), e.g. exu.MarkerType.Position | exu.MarkerType.Orientation; Assemble refuses markers that do not provide these types. ObjectJointUser always takes two rigid markers and needs no such parameter.
